places.name: Potemkin Stairs
places.ai_summary: A historic symbol of Odessa, the Potemkin Stairs offer stunning views of the harbor and are a masterpiece of urban design.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Climb to the top for the best views of the harbor.

places.ai_summary: A stunning architectural gem, the Odessa Opera and Ballet Theater hosts world-class performances in a grand setting.

opening_hours.notes: Performance times vary; check the schedule online.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance for popular shows.

places.ai_summary: A scenic boulevard in Odessa, Primorsky Boulevard is lined with historic landmarks, lush greenery, and stunning views of the Black Sea.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or evening.

places.place_tip: Take a leisurely stroll and enjoy the sea breeze.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for nightlife.

places.place_tip: Explore the side streets for hidden gems.

places.ai_summary: Home to a vast collection of artifacts, the Odessa Archaeological Museum offers a glimpse into the ancient history of the region.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission 30 minutes before closing.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for detailed insights.
